pages.headline: I-SA yamukela isinqumo se-ICJ sokuthi iMyanmar inecala lokubulala isizwe
pages.dek: Inkantolo iyalele iMyanmar ukuthi inikeze izisulu zaseRohingya isinxephezelo futhi iqinisekise ukuthi lokhu kungenzeki futhi.

pages.headline: Amadolobha ase-SA abeka imingcele yamanzi njengoba u-El Niño eqina
pages.dek: Isikhungo sase-US sokuBikezelwa Kwesimo Sezulu sithi amathuba okuba nesimo esinamandla kakhulu kuJanuwari-Mashi 2027 angaphezu kuka-79%.

pages.headline: UHill-Lewis uqala ihlandla lesibili njengemeya yaseKapa
pages.dek: I-Democratic Alliance igcine iningi layo elibonakalayo kuphela kumasipala waseNingizimu Afrika lapho iqembu linye liwine khona ukulawula, njengoba ebeka phambili izinto ezinhlanu.

pages.headline: IJohannesburg yandisausesho lomfana oneminyaka engu-11 okhukhuleke ezikhukhuleni zaseSoweto
pages.dek: Amaqembu asesha kusuka enqulwini yezibi ngamamitha angaba ngu-4 emahleni, namaphoyisa ezinja, abatshuza kanye namalungu omphakathi abamba iqhaza kulo msebenzi.

pages.headline: Ibhange LaseNingizimu Afrika ligcina i-repo rate ku-7.25%
pages.dek: Lesi sinqumo sigcina inzalo yokuqala isemazingeni ka-10.75%, yize amalungu ayisikhombisa ekomiti amathathu ayefuna ukukhuphuka kwamaphuzu ayi-25.
